meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将工作分解为系统化的证据驱动步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将复杂任务拆解为可执行的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Decompose work into systematic, evidence-driven steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break down complex tasks into actionable steps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用“超工作模式”将复杂任务分解为系统化的、有证据约束的步骤，并持续跟踪进度，直到目标完成。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ulw-loop”、“ulw”、持久目标执行、证据驱动工作、手动QA或带检查点的长期交付时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 帮我分解这个项目计划。
say.note: Claude 会打开工作流文件并开始分解任务。

say.text: 启动 ulw 模式，执行这个长期任务。
say.note: Claude 会进入证据驱动的执行循环。

say.text: 检查 ulw-loop 的当前状态。
say.note: Claude 会读取状态并报告进度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses 'ultrawork mode' to decompose complex tasks into systematic, evidence-bound steps and tracks progress until completion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop', 'ulw', durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break down this project plan.
say_en.note: Claude will open the workflow file and start decomposition.

say_en.text: Start ulw mode for this long-running task.
say_en.note: Claude will enter the evidence-driven execution loop.

say_en.text: Check the current status of ulw-loop.
say_en.note: Claude will read the state and report progress.
